title: Contract Validator
prompt: Implement validate_project(pyproject_text) returning a list of problem strings for a pyproject: missing [project], missing name, missing version, and any dependency without a version constraint (a bare package name in dependencies). A fully valid file returns [].

tests.name: valid file passes clean
tests.hint: Every check green → empty problem list.

tests.name: missing version flagged
tests.code:
text = '[project]\nname = "a"'
problems = validate_project(text)
assert any('version' in p for p in problems)
tests.hint: Report each missing field as a problem string.

tests.name: unpinned dependency flagged
tests.code:
text = '[project]
name = "a"
version = "0.1.0"
dependencies = ["requests"]'
problems = validate_project(text)
assert any('requests' in p for p in problems)
tests.hint: A dependency with no >=, <=, ==, ~, or ! is unpinned.
